bug_semantics: Renovate's child-process exec layer is supposed to hand child processes (npm/yarn/pnpm installs, postUpgradeTasks, postUpdateOptions, custom managers) only an allowlisted environment: lib/util/exec/env.ts `getChildProcessEnv()` returns `basicEnvVars` (proxy/HOME/PATH/LANG/DOCKER_*/SSL/COREPACK/etc.) plus explicitly requested keys, with full `process.env` only when `exposeAllEnv` is set. Commit e773b3243100 migrated `lib/util/exec/common.ts` from node `child_process.spawn` to `execa` without passing `extendEnv: false`; execa's default `extendEnv: true` merges the parent's complete `process.env` into `opts.env` before spawn. Every spawned child therefore received the Renovate process' full environment (hosting tokens like GITHUB_COM, endpoint secrets, self-hosted config credentials), so any package manager lifecycle script or post-upgrade command could exfiltrate them (CWE-200).
flaw_origin: Commit e773b3243100917c62ac5259f1a946447c4cd9e0 ("fix(util/exec): migrate to `execa` for command execution (#40212)", 2025-12-30, author Jamie Tanna <jamie.tanna@mend.io>, committer GitHub) replaced `spawn(cmd, {...opts, shell: true})` with `execa(cmd, {...opts})` in lib/util/exec/common.ts. node's spawn forwards exactly the `env` option — the allowlisted `childEnv` built by `getChildEnv()` in getRawExecOptions — whereas execa, by default (`extendEnv: true`), unions the supplied env with the parent's full `process.env`, silently voiding the basicEnvVars allowlist. First tag containing the commit: 42.68.1, matching the advisory's introduced-version floor 'from 42.68.1' (parent 73c14df4693 is contained in 42.68.0, so the boundary is exact). The allowlist itself (basicEnvVars, trustLevel/exposeAllEnv gate) originates in 69dabac27878 / 5fd6361c56e5 (2020-01, Sergio Zharinov) and was functioning correctly before this migration.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object names author Jamie Tanna, committer GitHub, plain human PR body (#40212); grep for claude/copilot/anthropic/openai/generated/co-authored/cursor/junie returns no hits (NONE-E773 sentinel).
evidence: Advisory (CVE-2026-76227 / GHSA-p44v-39mg-jgrj): Renovate versions from 42.68.1 before 42.96.3 (and from 42.68.1 before 43.4.4) fail to restrict environment variables to an allowlist when spawning child processes; child processes (npm install, postUpgradeTasks, postUpdateOptions) gain full access to all environment variables of the Renovate process, allowing exfiltration of secrets accessible to the deployment.

Allowlist design at 42.68.0: `git show 42.68.0:lib/util/exec/env.ts` — `getChildProcessEnv()` returns only `[...basicEnvVars, ...customEnvVars]` (full `process.env` only under `GlobalConfig.get('exposeAllEnv')`); `common.ts` used node `spawn(cmd, {...opts, shell: true})`, which forwards exactly `opts.env` (the allowlisted childEnv from `getChildEnv()` in getRawExecOptions) — children inherited only allowlisted vars.

BIC: `git show e773b3243100917c62ac5259f1a946447c4cd9e0 -- lib/util/exec/common.ts` — swaps `spawn` for `execa` (`import { execa } from 'execa'`) with no `extendEnv` option; execa's documented default `extendEnv: true` merges the parent's full `process.env` into the child env, voiding the allowlist. First tag containing e773b324 = 42.68.1 (release date 2025-12-30, same day); parent 73c14df4693 contained in 42.68.0 — exact match to the advisory's introduced-version boundary 42.68.1.

Fix: a825cac81b02 (main, 2026-02-09, Michael Kriese, "fix(exec): don't extend env (#41024)") adds `extendEnv: false` to the execa call in lib/util/exec/common.ts, restoring allowlist semantics; backport 9b59ffdad87d (cherry-pick of a825cac8, maint/42.x) first contained in tag 42.96.3, a825cac8 first contained in 43.4.4 — both exactly the advisory's fixed-version floors. Verified: `merge-base --is-ancestor 9b59ffdad87d 42.96.3` true; a825cac81b02 in 43.4.4 true.

AI-marker screening: `git log --format='%an <%ae>%n%cn <%ce>%n%B' -1` on e773b3243100 (BIC), a825cac81b02, 9b59ffdad87d, plus allowlist-origin commits 5fd6361c56e5/69dabac27878 and 11e30a08f609 — all human authors (Sergio Zharinov, Jamie Tanna, Michael Kriese, Sebastian Poxhofer), no AI/bot identities on any BIC or fix object (NONE sentinels).

Context: 42.68.1 also carried the shell-default regression fixed by f430552de4a0 ("fix(util/exec): don't use `shell` by default", in 42.68.5) and sibling hardening b017c7548ad6 (docker sidecar quoting, carries 'Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5' — remediation-side only, different sink, not this advisory's fix); neither changes the env-inheritance verdict.
reasoning: Vulnerability first: the advisory states children gain full Renovate env because the allowlist is not enforced, with introduced 42.68.1 and fixed 42.96.3/43.4.4. The code confirms the mechanism — getChildEnv() builds an allowlisted env, but the 42.68.1 execa migration makes execa (extendEnv:true default) union it with the parent's entire process.env; the fix is literally `extendEnv: false` in both release trains. BIC choice: e773b3243100 is the single commit that flipped inheritance semantics — it is first contained in exactly 42.68.1 (advisory floor) while its parent is in 42.68.0, and it created the named condition (full-env children). The 2020 allowlist origin (5fd6361c56e5/69dabac27878) is the security design the BIC defeated, not the flaw; the July-2023 refactor (11e30a08f609) and May-2026 util/env.ts moves only relocated unchanged logic. squash_decomposed=false: the whole flaw lives in one commit.
